title: Remove all scroll controls and implement manual smooth scrolling with fade-up animations

requirements.text: Remove all snap scroll behaviour from the entire app — eliminate any CSS scroll-snap properties (scroll-snap-type, scroll-snap-align), JavaScript-driven scroll locking, programmatic scroll jumps, and any auto-scroll or auto-advance movement across all components and pages.

quotes: Scroll must be fully manual and smooth
Remove completely: Snap scroll, Auto/programmatic scroll movement, Scroll locking behaviour

acceptanceCriteria: No scroll-snap-type or scroll-snap-align CSS rules exist anywhere in the frontend
No JavaScript programmatically calls window.scrollTo with smooth/instant or element.scrollIntoView in a way that hijacks user scrolling
Page scrolls freely at the user's own pace with no jumps, speed boosts, or locking

requirements.text: Remove all scroll control UI overlays: pagination dots, middle/center arrow icons, and any carousel navigation overlays from every component in the app (including ServiceCarousel, FeaturedReviewsCarousel, and any other carousel or slider components).

quotes: Remove completely: Pagination dots, Middle arrow icon, Any scroll control overlay

acceptanceCriteria: No pagination dot indicators are rendered anywhere on any page
No arrow/chevron navigation icons appear for scrolling or sliding
No overlay controls for scroll or carousel navigation are visible

requirements.text: Convert any carousel or slider components (ServiceCarousel, FeaturedReviewsCarousel) into plain static layouts — ServiceCarousel should render as a vertically stacked or simple grid list, and FeaturedReviewsCarousel should render all reviews in a static grid or list with no auto-advance. Remove all swipe handlers, interval timers, and navigation state from these components.

quotes: Scroll must be fully manual and smooth

acceptanceCriteria: ServiceCarousel renders as a static stacked/grid list with no sliding or auto-advance
FeaturedReviewsCarousel renders all fetched reviews statically with no auto-advance interval
No setInterval or setTimeout driving scroll/slide movement exists in these components

requirements.text: Add a very soft fade-up entrance animation (opacity 0→1, translateY 20px→0) to each major section on the Home page when it enters the viewport using IntersectionObserver. The animation must only trigger once per section and must not affect, block, or modify the user's scroll behaviour in any way — no scroll locking, no snap, no programmatic movement.

quotes: Only very soft fade-up animation when section enters viewport
Animation must not interfere with scrolling
Sections must appear from bottom → top, Smooth pop-up animation, Soft water-wave style entrance

acceptanceCriteria: Each home page section fades in softly from slightly below its natural position when it enters the viewport
Animation uses CSS transitions or keyframes only — no JS scroll manipulation
Scrolling remains 100% manual and smooth at all times during and after animations
Animation triggers once per section and does not re-trigger on scroll up

requirements.text: In the Services page, remove the 'View All Options' button entirely from all service category sections. When a main service category is clicked, all subcategory service cards must expand and display instantly with no extra click required. No dropdown toggle button or any similar control should remain.

quotes: View All Options button must be fully removed
All subcategory services must expand instantly
Show all services directly, No extra click required

acceptanceCriteria: No 'View All Options' button or equivalent toggle is rendered anywhere on the Services page
Clicking a main service category immediately shows all its subcategory cards without any secondary interaction
All subcategory services are visible directly after the first click on the parent category

constraints: Do not change any layout, colors, spacing, fonts, buttons, or visual design
Do not redesign any page or component
Do not modify backend logic or data structures
Animation must never interfere with manual scrolling
nonGoals: Changing the visual theme or branding
Adding any new scroll-based navigation patterns
